in_sanskrit.name: Dhannu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Giver, Donor
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dhannu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Dhannu means 'giver' or 'donor'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhanam' which means 'wealth' or 'property'. In Hindu mythology, Dhannu is a name given to the deity Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, who is the remover of obstacles and the bestower of blessings. He is often invoked when one seeks success, prosperity, or wealth.
